    ws_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    ask_id TEXT NOT NULL,

    source_title TEXT NOT NULL,                -- 1..120

tables.name: v2_asks
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE v2_asks (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,                       -- ask_<24 base32>
    ws_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES v2_workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    team_id TEXT NOT NULL,                     -- the team asked (a pod)
    goal_id TEXT,                              -- optional: the asked team's goal it concerns
    text TEXT NOT NULL,                        -- 1..400
    from_label TEXT,                           -- who asked, as people say it ("Faculty"), 1..80
    created_by TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- the person who recorded it
    source_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_kind IN ('meeting','manual')),
    source_title TEXT,                         -- 1..120, required for meeting
    source_date TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- YYYY-MM-DD
    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('open','accepted','done','declined','withdrawn')),
    decided_by TEXT,                           -- last person who changed state
    decided_at TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (ws_id, id),
    FOREIGN KEY (ws_id, team_id) REFERENCES v2_pods(ws_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (ws_id, goal_id) REFERENCES v2_goals(ws_id, id)
  )

indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX v2_asks_team ON v2_asks(ws_id, team_id, state)

tables.name: v2_goals

CREATE TABLE "v2_goals" (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    ws_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES v2_workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    pod_id TEXT,
    visibility TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (visibility IN ('private','pod','workspace')),
    version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    measures_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    anchors_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active','achieved','dropped')),
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    depends_on_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    level TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'team' CHECK (level IN ('company','team')), limits_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', target_share INTEGER CHECK (target_share IS NULL OR target_share BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
    UNIQUE (ws_id, id),
    CHECK (visibility <> 'pod' OR pod_id IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (level <> 'company' OR (pod_id IS NULL AND visibility = 'workspace')),
    FOREIGN KEY (ws_id, pod_id) REFERENCES v2_pods(ws_id, id)
  )

    note TEXT CHECK (note IS NULL OR length(note) <= 1000),
    author_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (reallocation_id, revision),
    FOREIGN KEY (ws_id, reallocation_id) REFERENCES v2_reallocations(ws_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  )

tables.name: v2_reallocations

CREATE TABLE v2_reallocations (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,                       -- rl_<24 base32>
    ws_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES v2_workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    requester_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending','countered','approved','rejected','withdrawn','superseded')),
    revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
    launch TEXT CHECK (launch IS NULL OR launch IN ('pending','not_yet','launched','superseded')),
    launch_by TEXT,
    launch_at TEXT,
    decided_by TEXT,
    decision_note TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    decided_at TEXT,
    UNIQUE (ws_id, id)
  )

tables.name: v2_receipts
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE "v2_receipts" (
    ws_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    directive_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('received','applied','enforced','accepted','declined')),
    at TEXT NOT NULL,
    recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    auto_accepted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (auto_accepted IN (0, 1) AND (auto_accepted = 0 OR state = 'accepted')),
    PRIMARY KEY (directive_id, session_key, state, auto_accepted),
    FOREIGN KEY (ws_id, directive_id, session_key) REFERENCES v2_directive_targets(ws_id, directive_id, session_key) ON DELETE CASCADE
  )

tables.name: v2_request_targets
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE v2_request_targets (
    ws_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    session_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('sent','received','accepted','declined','expired')),
    auto_accepted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (auto_accepted IN (0, 1)),
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, ended_reason TEXT CHECK (ended_reason IS NULL OR ended_reason IN ('device_signed_out','member_removed')),
    PRIMARY KEY (request_id, session_key),
    FOREIGN KEY (ws_id, request_id) REFERENCES v2_requests(ws_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (ws_id, session_key) REFERENCES v2_sessions(ws_id, session_key) ON DELETE CASCADE
  )

indexes.name: v2_request_targets_key

tables.name: v2_requests
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE v2_requests (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,                       -- rq_<24 base32>
    ws_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES v2_workspaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    goal_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('replan','checkpoint','switch_goal')),
    target_goal_id TEXT,                       -- switch_goal only
    goal_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
    note TEXT CHECK (note IS NULL OR length(note) <= 280),
    sender_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    sender_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (sender_role IN ('approver','owner')),
    directive_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    cancelled_at TEXT,
    cancelled_by TEXT,
    UNIQUE (ws_id, id),
    CHECK ((type = 'switch_goal') = (target_goal_id IS NOT NULL)),
    FOREIGN KEY (ws_id, goal_id) REFERENCES v2_goals(ws_id, id),
    FOREIGN KEY (ws_id, target_goal_id) REFERENCES v2_goals(ws_id, id),
    FOREIGN KEY (ws_id, directive_id) REFERENCES v2_directives(ws_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  )

    session_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    device_id TEXT REFERENCES v2_devices(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    harness TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (harness IN ('claude-code','codex')),
    repo_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    repo_alias TEXT,
    title TEXT,
    started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('shared','suspended','stopped')),

    governing_goal_id TEXT,

    agent_stopped INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    conflicts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    ended_reason TEXT CHECK (ended_reason IS NULL OR ended_reason IN ('device_signed_out','member_removed')),
    PRIMARY KEY (ws_id, session_key),
    FOREIGN KEY (ws_id, governing_goal_id) REFERENCES v2_goals(ws_id, id),
    FOREIGN KEY (ws_id, governing_alignment_id) REFERENCES v2_alignments(ws_id, id)
